description: This file defines a class `ADODB2_informix` that extends `ADODB_DataDict`. It provides methods for mapping metadata types, generating SQL for altering and dropping columns, and creating SQL suffixes specific to Informix databases, as part of the ADOdb database abstraction layer.

classes.name: ADODB2_informix
classes.description: A class providing Informix-specific data dictionary support for the ADOdb database abstraction layer, including type mapping and SQL generation.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Maps metadata type identifiers to actual database types, with support for custom meta types.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statement(s) to alter a column in a table; currently not supported and returns an empty array.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statement(s) to drop a column from a table; currently not supported and returns an empty array.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Constructs SQL suffixes for column definitions based on attributes such as default value, nullability, autoincrement, constraints, and primary key status.
